name: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!

adventurer, you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northwest. I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.
narrative.offerRewardText: Judging by the gaping wound in her side, Anilia is on the verge of death.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 32, 7,650 XP in all.

quests.name: The Branch of Cenarius
quests.objectiveText: Kill Geltharis and return the Branch of Cenarius to Illiyana at Forest Song.

quests.name: Satyr Slaying!
quests.objectiveText: Bring 16 Satyr Horns to Illiyana in Forest Song.
